name: code-quality
description: Code quality skills: finishing a change the same way every time (verified in the running app, simplified, checked, committed with the evidence); a parallel, verified review of a range of commits already on a branch, resuming where the last review stopped; a whole-codebase audit of one commit against its own designs, decisions, rules and docs, with proven coverage; and a safe, standards-based review of pull requests from outside contributors, people or AI agents, with a written verdict.
